about.label: About
about.heading: From clinical practice to project management and marketing
about.p1: I started out training in dental medicine, not project management. But while running online and in-person dental education programs — coordinating instructors, planning launches, writing the marketing, and managing the budget — I realized what actually energized me wasn't the clinical content itself. It was the work of pulling a project together: solving problems in real time, aligning people with very different priorities, and turning something complex into something that runs smoothly.
about.p2: My first project was a modest online course on a niche clinical topic. I learned the fundamentals there — how to position a course, write copy that converts, and manage a paid ad campaign from a near-empty toolkit. That project became the foundation for everything that came after: online courses with stronger positioning and performance, and eventually premium in-person programs with multiple industry sponsors and demanding logistics — the kind of projects where a single missed detail can throw off an entire event.
about.p3: Today I work across the full lifecycle of a course or campaign: project planning and timeline management, stakeholder and vendor coordination, marketing strategy and copywriting, paid advertising, and on-site execution. I'm now looking to bring that same skill set to project management, marketing, and healthcare education roles beyond the dental space — including international and remote opportunities.

aa.subtitle1: Launching a premium in-person dental aesthetics program from 0 → 1, led by Dr. Li — sold out within 24 hours of opening registration.
aa.subtitle2: 3-day in-person dental education program · 0 → 1 launch · 5-month timeline
aa.problem: The instructor, Dr. Li, had strong personal credibility but had never run a premium in-person course before. The program had to be built from zero — positioning, pricing, the enrollment funnel, and on-site delivery — all within a fixed 5-month window before the live course dates.
aa.myRole: End-to-end project manager: timeline and milestone planning, marketing coordination, participant communication, budget oversight, and on-site execution across all 3 course days.
aa.action: Built the enrollment page and course positioning; ran a lean teaser-to-enrollment ad funnel (172 clicks at a $0.10 CPC, $120 total spend); coordinated designers and vendors; managed payment and pre-course communication; ran logistics and problem-solving on-site across the 3-day live program.
aa.result: All 16 seats sold out within 24 hours of opening registration, generating $31K in revenue. Demand from the waiting list justified a second cohort, which sold out in 41 days with no additional advertising spend.
pr.subtitle1: Coordinating a multi-sponsor advanced surgical training program, led by Dr. Xu.
pr.problem: A high-standard instructor required an authentic clinical environment, including a full dental treatment unit inside the classroom, while coordinating expectations across three external industry sponsors.
pr.myRole: Project coordination, stakeholder and vendor management, course operations, and on-site event execution.
pr.action: Aligned expectations across three industry sponsors, and coordinated the precise installation and removal of a full clinical treatment unit for a live demonstration without disrupting the course schedule.
pr.result: All 16 seats sold out within 26 days with a waiting list of 4 dentists, delivered on an advertising spend of under $130.
oc.subtitle1: Turning raw course recordings into a marketable product, led by Dr. Su — built from scratch with no existing positioning or marketing material.
oc.subtitle2: Online dental education program · 2-month launch campaign
oc.problem: The instructor delivered finished course recordings but almost no marketing material. A highly technical, academic topic (occlusion) had to be turned into a clear, sellable product with no existing positioning or messaging to build on.
oc.myRole: Full launch owner: landing page copywriting, social content, ad creative strategy, Meta advertising management, course setup, and enrollment support.
oc.action: Segmented the audience into two clinical skill levels, wrote the positioning and full landing page from scratch, and built a multi-touch ad funnel (content → teaser → enrollment → countdown) across Meta and LINE.
oc.result: 92 orders at a 15.8x return on ad spend, reaching 84% of the campaign revenue target and a 7% order increase over the previous course launch.
dt.subtitle1: Built demand for a low-frequency, low-perceived-urgency clinical topic, led by Dr. Zhang and Dr. Liao, by reframing it around practical relevance rather than technical depth.
dt.subtitle2: Online dental education program · Sep – Nov 2025
dt.problem: Dental trauma is a lower-frequency clinical topic with less perceived urgency than more commonly discussed dental subjects, and the instructor team had already released other dental education programs, making differentiation harder.
dt.myRole: Project management, content marketing, advertising management, and enrollment operations for the full campaign.
dt.action: Reframed the course around practical, real-world relevance rather than technical depth, to build demand for a topic dentists don't encounter daily.
dt.result: 16.5x estimated return on ad spend, with the best campaign generating 604 clicks at a $0.10 CPC.
en.subtitle1: Marketed a niche endodontic specialty course into an already-saturated instructor catalog, led by Dr. Liao, by repositioning around practical clinical workflow gains rather than technical features.
en.subtitle2: Online dental education program · Specialized endodontic audience
en.problem: The instructor had already released multiple endodontic education programs, and the topic itself — ultrasonic-assisted treatment — served a narrow, highly specialized audience. The course needed a clear point of differentiation to stand out in an already-saturated catalog.
en.myRole: Product positioning, landing page copywriting, social content, Meta advertising management, course setup, and enrollment support.
en.action: Repositioned the course around practical clinical workflow gains rather than technical features, wrote the landing page and social content from scratch, and managed the Meta ad campaign end-to-end.
en.result: 52 orders at a 6.6x return on ad spend, with the best-performing creative reaching a $0.07 CPC.
